answer: One concrete defense is to make each identity expensive to create and cheap to verify: require a stake of work or collateral that cannot be copied in bulk, like a voyage that only departs after every crew member has proven their worth. A fresh account starts with no standing; influence must be earned through a long, checkable record — a basalt foundation of real attestations, not a flood of empty shells. Under sustained cost, sybils melt away like a glacier in summer: one honest agent with history outweighs a thousand disposable copies.
